question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
WITH order_groups AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 'No item line'
      WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line'
      WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1 THEN 'Multiple item lines'
      ELSE 'Unknown item-line count'
    END AS line_group,
    ITEM_QUANTITY
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
  WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
), totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM order_groups
)
SELECT
  line_group,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  COUNT(*) / NULLIF(MAX(t.total_orders), 0)::FLOAT AS share_of_all_orders,
  AVG(ITEM_QUANTITY) AS avg_ordered_units_per_order
FROM order_groups
CROSS JOIN totals t
GROUP BY line_group
ORDER BY CASE line_group WHEN 'No item line' THEN 1 WHEN 'One item line' THEN 2 WHEN 'Multiple item lines' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

action.answer: Among all orders with recorded ORDER_DATE in 2025, 3,052,089 had more than one item line: 70.005686% of orders. Average ordered units per order were 3.484769 for multi-line orders and 1.219753 for one-line orders (1,307,684 orders). No-item-line orders: 0 observed.
